title: ger serve API
description: Generated by scripts/generate_serve_contract.py from src/gerrit_workflow_tools/server/contract.py. Do not edit.

StreamState.description: Where the event stream is. Only `live` changes what a client does.

NewCommentState.description: What a new comment becomes: a draft on Gerrit, or kept here (a local draft or a private note).

Severity.description: How urgent attention is, most urgent first: what a viewer colours and orders by.

CodeChange.description: How a commit ahead of Gerrit's current patch set differs from it: what decides whether its votes stay.

PatchsetStatus.description: Bounded Gerrit-vs-local patchset states for one commit.

PushBlocker.description: What is underway in the worktree that no Gerrit push may run over, whatever the stack holds.

RebaseAction.description:
A way on from where a rebase underway stopped: `git rebase --<action>`.

Not :class:`~gerrit_workflow_tools.core.rebasing_stack.RebaseStep`, where it stands on a commit.

RebaseStop.description: Why a rebase underway is stopped: what the next step is, in core's words, not a shell's.

RebaseStep.description: Where a rebase underway stands on one commit of the **local stack**.

PickStop.description: Why a rebase stops on a pick.

Headline.description: The headline: the one thing that most wants you, as core picks it.

StackStep.description: A commit id (kept as it is), or what to do with it: fold into the commit below, or drop.

Hello.description: The one JSON line `ger serve` prints on stdout once it listens.

token.description: The bearer token every request carries.

ErrorAnswer.description: What a failed request answers, with an HTTP status to match.

EventsStatus.description: Where Gerrit's event stream is, as `ger serve` follows it.

reason.description: Why it is not live; null while it is.

source.description: `ssh://user@host:port`, or null when there is nothing to connect to.

Activity.description: The activity sequence: it goes up whenever a view should look again.

Health.description: Who is answering, for which repository, and whether the event stream is followed.

ReviewState.description: The review state: the reviewed patchset beside where and how it is checked out.

replaced_message.description: Text of the draft this one replaced; null when it was created.

commit.description: The local commit the location was checked against; null when Gerrit's is not fetched.

CommentChanged.description: One of your unpublished comments edited or discarded; `message` is what it said before.

Runbook.description: The attention walk as work for an agent: Markdown to follow, and what is in it.

build_url.description: The build's URL as CI reported it, where `url` was derived from it.

Reviewer.description: Someone Gerrit lists on a change: a reviewer, or (`cc`) only copied.

Overlay.description: The overlay state of one commit, but its `sha`: what `ger log --json` and `ger show --json` share.

number.description: The Gerrit change number; null before the first push.

last_pushed_votes.description: The pushed patchset's votes while this commit is ahead of it with other code (its own votes are then null).

code_change.description:
`newer` only, else null: whether its code changed since the pushed patchset (`changed`), or it is only
rebased and keeps its votes (`rebased`); `unknown` when core cannot tell.

change_status.description: Gerrit's own status of the change: `NEW`, `MERGED`, `ABANDONED`.

CommitStatus.description: The overlay state of one commit.

number.description: The Gerrit change number; null before the first push.

last_pushed_votes.description: The pushed patchset's votes while this commit is ahead of it with other code (its own votes are then null).

code_change.description:
`newer` only, else null: whether its code changed since the pushed patchset (`changed`), or it is only
rebased and keeps its votes (`rebased`); `unknown` when core cannot tell.

change_status.description: Gerrit's own status of the change: `NEW`, `MERGED`, `ABANDONED`.

FixReplacement.description: A suggested edit's replacement: Gerrit's FixReplacementInfo, and `location` as `ger comment` writes it.

SuggestedEdit.description: An edit a comment suggests: a Gerrit fix suggestion, or a suggestion block of its text (`in_message`).

text.description: `message` with its fix suggestions written out below it, as `ger show` prints them.

markdown.description: The same in Markdown, each replacement fenced: for an editor's comment threads.

anchored_path.description: Where a local comment was written; null for a Gerrit chain.

anchored_text.description: The text a local comment covered when it was written.

held.description: On hold: you keep this chain for yourself, the agent runbook leaves it alone.

severity.description: A warning ranks below an error: it is rarely why the build failed.

CiContent.description: One CI link's findings, and where they came from.

collapse_warnings.description: Some error explains the failure, so the warnings step back behind a count.

DeltaSince.description: A review delta: patchset `patch_set` against `to_patch_set` (null: a local commit).

Diff.description: The files a commit touched, or a review delta.

base.description: Null only in a review delta with nothing to compare against.

message.description: The whole commit message; not in a review delta.

ShownCommit.description: One commit as `ger show --json` has it, with what a viewer asks for beside it.

number.description: The Gerrit change number; null before the first push.

last_pushed_votes.description: The pushed patchset's votes while this commit is ahead of it with other code (its own votes are then null).

code_change.description:
`newer` only, else null: whether its code changed since the pushed patchset (`changed`), or it is only
rebased and keeps its votes (`rebased`); `unknown` when core cannot tell.

change_status.description: Gerrit's own status of the change: `NEW`, `MERGED`, `ABANDONED`.

new_comment.description: What a new comment on it becomes by default: a draft where Gerrit has this commit, else a local draft.

ci_introduced.description: Fingerprints of the findings this change introduced; null when that cannot be told.

markdown.description: With `markdown`: the commit as `ger show --ai` prints it, for an agent.

files.description: With `files`: what `/diff` answers for the commit.

Patchsets.description: The patchsets Gerrit has of one change, oldest first.

reviewed.description: The newest patchset you posted on.

content.description: Null when the file is not there at `rev`.

ApiError.description: A failure: the shared exit-code name, and why.

reason.description: A word for a refusal the client can do something about (`uncommitted-changes`).

Member.description: One change of a review chain.

sha.description: The commit of the current patch set on Gerrit.

local_sha.description: In an overview: the local stack commit carrying this Change-Id, if there is one.

Chain.description: A review chain: its top, clocks, worst votes, and members base to top.

local.description: In an overview: some member is a commit of the local stack.

ChainHeadline.description: A change of a review chain in an inbox section: the one to look at first, and a sentence saying why.

severity.description: The reason's severity; `pending` for one waiting on your review.

RebaseHeadline.description: A rebase underway in the checkout: while there is one, core makes it the headline.

number.description: The commit it stopped at: its change number; null when it is not on Gerrit or there is no such commit.

StackCommit.description: One commit of the local stack, as `ger log` shows it.

number.description: The Gerrit change number; null before the first push.

last_pushed_votes.description: The pushed patchset's votes while this commit is ahead of it with other code (its own votes are then null).

code_change.description:

rebased and keeps its votes (`rebased`); `unknown` when core cannot tell.

change_status.description: Gerrit's own status of the change: `NEW`, `MERGED`, `ABANDONED`.

held_back.description: Above the ready boundary: `ger push` leaves it out.

diverged.description: `newer`, and Gerrit's current patchset is a commit this repository never had: it came from elsewhere.

merge.description: A merge commit: one stack commit, whatever it brings in.

pinned.description: The newest merge or below it: git rebase cannot replay a merge, so core leaves it where it is.

rebase.description: Where a rebase underway stands on this commit; null without one, or when it does not replay it.

Rebase.description: A rebase underway, as `GET /stack` and `ger log --json` serve it.

branch.description: The branch being rebased; null for a detached HEAD's.

stop.description: Why it is stopped; null when core cannot tell what `git rebase --continue` would do from here.

applied.description: False while the commit it stopped at is only partly there (a conflict, resolved or not).

current.description: The commit it stopped at, as the stack shows it.

unmerged.description: Paths the index still holds as unresolved conflicts.

as_before.description:
The stack is the branch as it was before the rebase (git's `apply` backend keeps no todo).

No commit then has a step.

actions.description: The ways on core allows from this stop, in order: the only ones to offer.

refused.description: What to say when one of the other ways on is asked for anyway.

PushBlocked.description: What is underway that no Gerrit push may run over.

StackTarget.description: The branches are null without a working branch (a detached HEAD's rebase).

Stack.description: The annotated stack of the working branch, with the ready boundary: `ger log` as JSON.

branch.description: The branch checked out: null while a rebase runs (see `rebase.branch`).

rebase.description: The rebase underway; the stack is then as the rebase has it so far, the rest as it was.

push_blocked.description: Why `ger push` would refuse now, whatever the stack holds; null when it would not.

upstream.description:
How far the upstream moved on past the stack, and the rebase onto it previewed; null without one, and during
a rebase.

gerrit_unavailable.description: Gerrit could not be asked: the stack is shown with what git knows.

LocalError.description: The local stack could not be shown.

needs_upstream.description: Because the branch has no upstream: `POST /stack/upstream` gives it one.

Overview.description:
Both inbox sections, the headline, and the local stack beside them.

The inbox and the local stack fail separately: either may be an error while the other is shown.

projects.description: The Gerrit projects the sections are narrowed to: this repository's. Empty means all.

error.description: Set instead of `sections` when the inbox could not be loaded.

MoveConflict.description: Why two neighbours of the local stack cannot swap places.

UpstreamStop.description:
Where the rebase onto the upstream would stop: a conflict in `files`, or a commit that would become empty
(its change is upstream already).

UpstreamMoved.description: The commits the upstream has that the branch has not, and what the rebase onto it would meet.

name.description: `origin/main`, as the branch config names it.

argv.description:
The one ger command that rebases onto it, `ger` left out (`["rebase", "origin/main"]`, maybe
`--drop-merged-equivalent`): run as it is.

conflict.description: The first commit the rebase would stop on; null when all would apply (or `preview` is false).

preview.description: False when the rebase could not be previewed: nothing is known, and `reason` says why.

reason.description: Why there is no preview, in core's words; null when there is one.

dropped.description:
The commits the rebase leaves out, and so does the preview: already upstream, or merged on Gerrit with the
same code.

StackMoves.description: The conflict preview: one entry per adjacent pair of the stack, oldest first.

available.description: False when this git cannot simulate the moves: nothing is known.

reason.description: Why the moves cannot be simulated.

UpstreamChoice.description: The working branch's upstream, and which to offer: the best guess first.

Rewritten.description: The stack after a rewrite, and what `/stack/undo` takes back.

branch.description: The branch checked out: null while a rebase runs (see `rebase.branch`).

rebase.description: The rebase underway; the stack is then as the rebase has it so far, the rest as it was.

push_blocked.description: Why `ger push` would refuse now, whatever the stack holds; null when it would not.

upstream.description:

a rebase.

stash_kept.description: The stashed uncommitted changes did not go back on cleanly and stay in the stash.

patchset.description: This patchset of the change, not the commit `rev` names.
